classification_evidence: Morton is a lower-density, car-oriented small community. Census QuickFacts reports 1,336.4 people per square mile in 2020 and a 16.6-minute mean commute. Relevant routed peers at 20.94 and 22.41 minutes support retaining the repository's 30-minute exurban extended context. No catchment density surface or trip-tolerance study was completed.

method_notes.routing: Only five subject-origin point-to-point OSRM routes succeeded. There is no polygon isochrone and no patient-origin choice set.
method_notes.demographics: Morton city values are city_context_only. No city, ZIP, or county value is assigned to a fixed drive-time window.
method_notes.supply: The named routed alternatives are observations from a bounded peer list, not a complete geocoded and deduplicated office census.
method_notes.providers: No NPPES provider join or provider-address cleaning was completed.
method_notes.clinical_demand: No CDC PLACES overlay or block-group-weighted chronic-demand calculation was completed.
method_notes.vision_demand_units: VDU is not calculated because fixed-window population, age, diabetes, and commercial-pay inputs are unavailable.
method_notes.reviews: No independent review export is available. Count, recency, response, and peer normalization remain unknown.
